groups.defect: `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` does nothing when destinationCalendar is null, so the collective team members' calendars are silently dropped.
groups.rationale: Both point at the same lines in handleNewBooking and report the same null-initialization problem with the same fix.

groups.defect: `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` has no optional chaining, so it throws a TypeError for Google Meet bookings when destinationCalendar is null or empty.
groups.rationale: All of these point at EventManager line 119 and report the same missing optional chaining.

groups.defect: In Google updateEvent and deleteEvent, the fallback `find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` compares against a value that is already falsy, so it never matches and the calendarId ends up undefined or falls back to primary. Both places need to fall back to the destination calendar's externalId.
groups.rationale: It is the same dead predicate copied into updateEvent and deleteEvent. Several members report both places, which links the single-place reports together.

groups.defect: In createAllCalendarEvents, the no-credentialId branch calls createEvent without destination.externalId, so the stored reference has no externalCalendarId.
groups.rationale: Both report the same missing argument at the same lines and propose the same fix.

groups.defect: Booking references for video (non-calendar) results are now saved with credentialId undefined instead of result.credentialId.
groups.rationale: Both point at EventManager lines 169-170 and describe the same regression.
